_note: Expected output of quarantine_lib.redact_for_gateway() for every meeting in fixtures/granola_meetings.json. Non-quarantined meetings pass through unmodified (not listed here -- see fixtures/expected_quarantine.json for which ids those are: gr-1003, gr-1004, gr-1005).

meetings.justification: Title is unconditionally templated to 'Client sync (<dominant>)' per SKILL.md §3d -- there is no 'keep title if no client hints' branch in SKILL.md; ALL quarantined titles get this treatment regardless of the original wording. attendees=2 is a count, not the participant list.
Same as gr-1001; the client-domain host is redacted along with every other participant, surviving only as part of attendees=2.
Fail-closed quarantine with no known client domain -> dominant='unknown', attendees=0 because known_participants was never present.
Dominant domain 'goengen.com' comes straight from bob@goengen.com's host match -- the folder_hit signal also fired but does not change the dominant-domain selection logic.

Dominant is 'natera.com' (first CLIENT_DOMAINS entry with a participant match), NOT the alphabetical tie-break used by client-mapping ('engen') -- these are two different, intentionally-divergent rules; see expected_client_mapping.json. attendees=3 lets the drafter still say 'N client calls totaling Xh' without any names/emails surviving.

aggregate_example.justification: Demonstrates the reason duration_minutes survives redaction: the drafter can say '5 client calls totaling 2h20m' from redacted objects alone, with zero meeting bodies or participant emails involved.
